name: IE University
summary: Private university in Segovia and Madrid with English-taught bachelor's and five-year dual degrees, its own test and an interview.

ib.text: Full IB Diploma, first-sitting results only. Most admits score 34–45 (student average 36). IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT) and an interview.

dates.label: Round 3 application deadline, the last round; from May 2027 only while places remain

programmes.name: Bachelor in Applied Mathematics
programmes.about: A demanding maths degree mixing theory, computation and applied work: modelling real systems and optimising decisions for finance, operations, energy and sustainability.
programmes.overview: The first two years lay a common mathematical foundation, and in years three and four you specialise in industrial mathematics, artificial intelligence or financial mathematics, depending on availability. The course trains you to turn real situations into mathematical models and optimise decisions under constraints, with theory, numerical work and coding side by side; you also learn to write in LaTeX, present scientific posters and draft manuscripts, with a touch of quantum computing. A capstone project closes the degree, and internships and exchanges are encouraged. Graduates go into roles such as data scientist, machine learning engineer, quantitative trader or cryptography specialist, or into research.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

family.name: Applied Mathematics
family.differs: The single bachelor's degree: 4 years.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Architectural Studies
programmes.about: Project-based architecture training on the Segovia campus, combining creative, technical, environmental and social design with an internship programme.
programmes.overview: Studied entirely in Segovia, the programme is built around design studios that copy the way a firm or agency works, plus a Fab Lab for digital fabrication and a bio lab for materials. Alongside core architecture courses you take modules in design entrepreneurship, experimentation and management. In the second semesters of years two, three and four you work in studios, magazines, museums, NGOs or architecture firms around the world, and an optional diploma in product, graphic or interior design can be added. The degree leads to the one-year master's in architecture needed for professional licensure in Spain and across the European Union.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Behavior and Social Sciences
programmes.credential: Bachelor in Behavior and Social Sciences
programmes.about: Human behaviour studied with business and analytics tools, with elective tracks in human-centred consulting and marketing and talent strategy.
programmes.overview: Human behaviour is studied together with business and analytics, so you learn why people think and choose as they do, how organisations change, and how to measure and predict behaviour with data. The practical curriculum includes projects with real businesses, and you choose one of two elective tracks: human-centred consulting, where you solve challenges for real clients, or marketing and talent strategy, built around an AI-powered business simulation. The first year can be spent in Segovia before moving to Madrid. Graduates work as consultants, HR and talent managers, consumer behaviour analysts, market researchers and customer experience designers.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Business Administration
programmes.about: Core business disciplines from finance to marketing, applied through hands-on projects with companies; start in Segovia or spend all four years in Madrid.
programmes.overview: Fundamentals courses in finance, marketing and the other core business disciplines are combined with practical courses in which you carry out projects for real companies and organisations, and with broadening electives in humanities and technology. You build business plans and start-up projects, and track your own progress on a personal dashboard. The first two years can be spent in Segovia, with years three and four in Madrid, or all four in Madrid. Graduates become consultants, financial managers, marketing managers or entrepreneurs.

family.name: Business Administration
family.differs: Based in Spain: start in Segovia or Madrid, with optional exchanges abroad.

programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

programmes.name: Global Bachelor in Business Administration
programmes.city: Madrid, Singapore, Dubai; year 4 Madrid or New York
programmes.about: The same BBA degree studied across campuses: Madrid, Singapore and Dubai, with the final year in Madrid or New York City.
programmes.overview: You spend four years in four places: the first in Madrid, the second in Singapore, the third in Dubai, and the fourth in Madrid or New York City. Each stop builds on business foundations in finance, management and economics, through practical projects, business sprints, labs, corporate challenges and regional business treks, plus non-credit sessions on geopolitics and geoeconomics. In the final year you either graduate in Madrid with one of eight concentrations or take a 3+1 pathway in New York that adds a master's. Graduates aim for roles such as global strategy consultant, business development manager, global marketing manager or cross-border entrepreneur.

family.name: Business Administration
family.differs: Moves each year: Madrid, Singapore and Dubai, then Madrid or New York; higher fee.

programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Communication and Digital Media
programmes.credential: Bachelor in Communication and Digital Media
programmes.about: Branding and marketing communication with a hands-on, technology-led approach: building messages that work for global audiences.
programmes.overview: Strategic and critical analysis of cultural trends, audiences and media environments sits alongside creativity taught as a method, through design thinking, semiotics and narrative construction. You build fluency in written, visual, audio and interactive content, treating platforms as cultural environments rather than just channels. Hands-on projects take place in the MediaLab, where students produce content, test strategies and defend their choices with evidence. The first years can be spent in Segovia, building programming and technical skills, before moving to Madrid. Graduates go into advertising, branding, digital content, media strategy, and brand and marketing management.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence
programmes.credential: Bachelor in Computer Science and AI
programmes.about: An engineering-focused computer science degree: programming, algorithms, software engineering and systems, with AI, machine learning and robotics.
programmes.overview: The core is engineering-focused: programming, algorithms, data structures, software engineering, systems architecture and applied mathematics, joined with machine learning, AI and robotics. Teaching follows a project-based tech-studio approach with industry collaboration and technical experimentation from the first year. You can start in Segovia and finish in Madrid, close to the city's technology companies and start-ups, or study in Madrid throughout. Graduates become software, machine learning, AI, cloud, cybersecurity or site reliability engineers, systems architects, technical product managers or research scientists.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

family.name: Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence
family.differs: The single bachelor's degree: 4 years.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Data and Business Analytics
programmes.credential: Bachelor in Data and Business Analytics
programmes.about: Collecting, managing and analysing data to solve business and institutional problems, taught by IE's School of Science and Technology.
programmes.overview: You learn to collect, manage and analyse data with current analytics tools, and to turn the results into decisions for companies and institutions. Teaching is applied, with datathons, challenges and practical class projects tackling complex real-world problems, and the course develops a critical way of breaking problems down. The first part can be spent in Segovia before moving to Madrid, or all four years can be in Madrid. Graduates become data scientists, business intelligence and analytics consultants, data solutions architects or data officers.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

family.name: Data and Business Analytics
family.differs: The single bachelor's degree: 4 years.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Design
programmes.about: Multidisciplinary design with a business perspective, from digital environments to products and services; optional diplomas in interior, graphic or product design.
programmes.overview: A broad design foundation covers the history of design, drawing for analysis and communication, 3D visualisation, social sciences, sustainability and modern technology, combined with a business side that includes business plans, sales processes and project management. Learning is project-based, with real prototypes and a Design Council in which professional partners share projects in progress for students and faculty to research and answer. The first two years are in Segovia and the last two in Madrid, and you can add an optional diploma in visual communication, product design or interior design. Graduates work as graphic, product, interior or service designers, design strategists and creative consultants.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

family.name: Design
family.differs: The single bachelor's degree: 4 years.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Economics
programmes.about: Econometrics, political science, analytics and behavioural science applied to the digital economy, with a finance or policy-analysis specialisation.
programmes.overview: Econometrics, political science, applied analytics, behavioural science and technology are studied together, including the effects of automation, e-platforms, artificial intelligence and big data on the economy, and behavioural and experimental economics. The first three years build the foundations, and in the fourth you specialise in either country, sector and policy analysis or economic and financial analysis for business. The first two years can be in Segovia before moving to Madrid. Graduates work as economic consultants, financial market analysts, policy developers, equity analysts and government research consultants.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Environmental Sciences for Sustainability
programmes.about: Science first: biology, chemistry, physics, geology, ecology and data science, joined with environmental policy and governance, on the Segovia campus.
programmes.overview: Biology, chemistry, physics, geology, ecology and data science are studied together with environmental policy and governance, without having to specialise early. Teaching is science-first and practical, with fieldwork in the countryside around Segovia, lab experimentation, quantitative analysis and project work with stakeholders from industry, government and society. The programme looks closely at topics such as the energy transition and the green economy, and all four years take place in Segovia. Graduates become water resource and ecosystem analysts, environmental data analysts, renewable energy and impact analysts, or climate risk analysts.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Fashion Design
programmes.about: Fashion design with a focus on sustainability and fashion management, combining traditional craft with new technologies.
programmes.overview: Project-based design studios guide you through making garments, accessories and collections while confronting the material, economic, social and cultural factors behind them. Sustainability, fashion management, the blend of traditional craft with new technology, and entrepreneurship run through the course, and faculty are working professionals in the industry. The first two years are in Segovia and the last two in Madrid, and you can add a diploma in product design, visual communication or interior design. Graduates go on to found their own labels or work as stylists, textile designers, costume designers, sustainability consultants and virtual fashion designers.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

family.name: Fashion Design

programmes.name: Bachelor in Humanities
programmes.about: A multidisciplinary humanities degree that adds analytical, digital and quantitative tools to critical thinking about complex problems.
programmes.overview: Traditional disciplines such as history, philosophy and art are combined with digital tools including algorithmic thinking, coding and data mining, so critical thinking is paired with quantitative skills. Faculty include humanities scholars and practitioners from the digital field, and the degree develops creativity, communication, ethics, foresight and cultural awareness. The first two years are in Segovia and the last two in Madrid, with exchange options and an immersion experience in Paris. Graduates work as technology ethics consultants, cultural institution managers, content creators, UX researchers, heritage experts or game creative directors.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

family.name: Humanities
family.differs: The single bachelor's degree: 4 years.

programmes.name: Bachelor in International Relations
programmes.about: International affairs for careers in the public, private and non-profit sectors, drawing on IE's School of Politics and the UN System Staff College.
programmes.overview: The curriculum is organised around the five themes of the UN's sustainable development agenda (people, planet, prosperity, peace and partnership) and gives a grounding in the economic, political and cultural sides of global problems. Learning is practice-based, with case studies and policy-lab seminars, and a partnership with the United Nations System Staff College brings UN courses, practitioners, summer research programmes, mentoring and capstone projects. An exchange programme is part of the degree, and the first two years can be in Segovia. Graduates go into the UN and other multilateral bodies, diplomacy, consultancies, NGOs, think tanks, political parties and humanitarian work.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

family.name: International Relations
family.differs: The single bachelor's degree: 4 years.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.)
programmes.about: An English-taught law degree centred on international, European and transnational law, taught comparatively, with professional internships.
programmes.overview: The degree is taught in English with a comparative approach to international, European and transnational law, and you can follow a track in international business law, human rights and social justice, or digital law and technology. A concentration in Spanish business law is available in Spanish. Practice runs through the course in a mentoring programme, a legal clinic, hands-on capstone work and professional internships at law firms, and exchanges and dual degrees with partner law schools can lead to an LL.M. alongside the bachelor. Graduates work as corporate and international lawyers, legal advisers to NGOs, or legal tech specialists.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

family.name: Laws (LL.B.)
family.differs: The single bachelor's degree: 4 years.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Philosophy, Politics, Law and Economics (PPLE)
programmes.about: Philosophy, politics, law and economics together, with the option to specialise in one or two of them; aimed at governance and public policy.
programmes.overview: Philosophy, politics, law and economics are studied together, with the freedom to specialise in one or two of them, so you gain critical analysis, logical argument and ways of weighing governance, legal and economic questions. Learning combines theory with case studies, seminars, consultancy projects, international competitions and real-life projects. The first two years can be in Segovia before moving to Madrid. Graduates go into policy making, think tanks, political advice, law, strategy advice, NGOs, government and international organisations.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Political Science
programmes.about: How power, institutions and public policy shape societies, with public administration and leadership training for designing policy solutions.
programmes.overview: Political science, public policy, public administration and leadership are combined to show how power, institutions and governance shape societies, with attention to regulation, public affairs, democratic resilience and the effects of AI, data analytics, GovTech and cybersecurity on policy. Teaching is practical, through policy labs, consulting-style projects, study trips and real-world projects, with partnerships involving GESDA, Google and the International Telecommunication Union. The first years can be in Segovia, with exchange options. Graduates move into public policy, public affairs, government relations, consulting, advocacy and research.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

family.name: Political Science
family.differs: The single bachelor's degree: 4 years.

programmes.name: Dual Degree Bachelor in Business Administration and Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.)
programmes.about: Two degrees in five years: international business seen from both a management and a legal perspective, taught by IE Business School and IE Law School.
programmes.overview: Law and business are taught as one integrated plan: the first year gives foundations in both fields, then later years go deeper into economics, globalisation, entrepreneurship and corporate law, with a comparative-law approach and an international focus. The two schools involved, the business school and the law school, share teaching, and you graduate with two undergraduate diplomas. The programme is taught in Madrid. Graduates go into roles such as corporate lawyer in multinationals, legal adviser to international companies, project finance lawyer, investment banking associate or entrepreneur.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

programmes.name: Dual Degree Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) and Bachelor in International Relations
programmes.about: Two degrees in five years: global law and international affairs, aimed at international law and public and political careers.
programmes.overview: Law and international relations are merged into one study plan: the first year gives a broad base in both, and later years turn to globalisation, international affairs, conflict resolution and public law, building negotiation, crisis management and persuasion skills. The programme draws on the law school and the school of politics, economics and global affairs, is taught in Madrid, and ends in two undergraduate diplomas. It suits students aiming at public-sector legal work. Graduates become diplomats, human rights lawyers, foreign policy consultants, international criminal or arbitration lawyers and NGO advocates.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

programmes.credential: BBA + Bachelor in Computer Science and AI
programmes.about: Two degrees in five years: business administration with computer science and artificial intelligence, for tech-driven leadership roles.
programmes.overview: Computer science foundations in programming, algorithms, data structures, software engineering and mathematics are studied alongside business strategy, management and entrepreneurship, with artificial intelligence and modern computing linked to how they change organisations. Industry professionals teach on the programme, and Madrid's technology and business community is close at hand. Graduates aim to bridge engineering and business as entrepreneurs, consultants, machine learning engineers, blockchain developers or digital strategists.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

programmes.name: Dual Degree in Business Administration & Data and Business Analytics
programmes.credential: BBA + Bachelor in Data and Business Analytics
programmes.about: Two degrees in five years: management combined with statistical and data-analysis skills for the corporate world.
programmes.overview: Management is combined with data: you learn statistical tools to formulate and analyse data, and use them to guide business decisions and add value in sectors from finance to healthcare. Faculty come from both the business and data fields, and you can choose from internships, exchange programmes and other professional initiatives. You earn two undergraduate diplomas. Graduates work as fintech specialists, customer insight directors, marketing intelligence managers, talent analytics leads or trading specialists.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

family.name: Data and Business Analytics
family.differs: Dual degree with the Bachelor in Business Administration: both degrees in 5 years.

programmes.name: Dual Degree in Business Administration & Design
programmes.about: Two degrees in five years: business administration and design, for creative students who want to build value inside companies.
programmes.overview: Business administration and design are blended into one programme in which you work with professors and industry professionals on how a company operates and how design shapes products, services and human experience. It is hands-on and aimed at creative students who want to build human-centred solutions inside businesses. You graduate with two undergraduate diplomas. Graduates become innovation managers, strategy and innovation consultants, creative officers, user experience designers, customer experience researchers, business model designers or brand strategists.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

programmes.name: Dual Degree in Business Administration & Fashion Design
programmes.about: Two degrees in five years: business administration and fashion design, from industry trends and supply chains to branding.
programmes.overview: A five-year programme in which fashion design and business administration run together, covering industry trends, supply chains and branding, with sustainability, circularity, inclusivity and social responsibility at the centre. The design side is practical, based on making, testing and critiquing in a fab lab, a fashion studio and a tech lab, balanced by practical business projects, and there are international exchange opportunities. Graduates become founders and creative directors of their own labels, fashion buyers, brand managers, sustainability managers or marketing managers.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

programmes.name: Dual Degree in Business Administration & Humanities
programmes.about: Two degrees in five years: the analytical and critical skills of the humanities joined with business and management.
programmes.overview: The analytical, digital and critical-thinking skills of the humanities are joined with the management and quantitative tools of a business degree. You study subjects such as history, philosophy, literature and ethics, to read patterns of cause and consequence, assess information critically and communicate clearly, alongside business training. Faculty include scholars and practitioners from both worlds. You graduate with two degrees. Graduates work as strategy consultants, marketing and communications specialists, business development managers, corporate affairs specialists or entrepreneurs.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

programmes.name: Dual Degree in Business Administration & International Relations
programmes.about: Two degrees in five years: international business and international affairs, with the option of an exchange.
programmes.overview: Business administration is paired with international relations, giving a base in business, geopolitics and current affairs and a view of how companies and states deal with one another across borders. The programme is practice-based, with specialised training in negotiation, strategy and public speaking, and theory is put to work in summer internships or university labs, with exchanges open at a large network of partner institutions. It is taught in Madrid and ends in two undergraduate diplomas. Graduates go on to consult for international organisations, work in multinationals or NGOs, or become social entrepreneurs.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

programmes.name: Dual Degree in Business Administration and Political Science
programmes.about: Two degrees in five years: business education with political systems and governance, for public- and private-sector careers.
programmes.overview: Business strategy and political science are studied side by side, to show how companies, governments and international institutions interact and how political decisions move markets. Hands-on projects, policy labs and collaborations with organisations such as GESDA, Google and the International Telecommunication Union take up issues like AI governance, digital transformation, sustainability, international cooperation and geopolitical risk. The aim is a graduate who can shape corporate strategy, read regulatory and political change, advise organisations or build ventures with an international reach.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

programmes.name: Dual Degree in Economics & Applied Mathematics
programmes.about: Two degrees in five years: the modern global economy analysed with the tools of applied mathematics.
programmes.overview: The economics half covers econometrics, political science, applied analytics, behavioural science and technology, while the mathematics half covers calculus, linear algebra, statistics, differential equations, mathematical modelling, programming and machine learning. You learn to apply mathematical language to real economic problems using various programming languages. The result is a profile suited to finance, economic consulting, data analysis and sustainable development. Graduates become financial data analysts, econometric analysts, risk management consultants, financial modelling specialists or data scientists in economic analysis.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on your grades, IE's own test (or SAT, ACT, LNAT), CV and an online interview; earlier rounds have more places.

programmes.name: Dual Degree in Economics & International Relations
programmes.about: Two degrees in five years: economics and international relations, for designing policy between states, companies and international organisations.
programmes.overview: Economics, history, politics and international relations are combined, with an emphasis on how states, businesses, international organisations, NGOs and think tanks relate to one another. You learn to design and lead strategic policy for global problems, drawing on digital platforms and emerging technologies and on advanced analytical tools. Learning includes partnerships that let students learn by doing, and exchanges abroad. Graduates work in international financial institutions, development banks, policy making, think tanks, economic research, journalism or social entrepreneurship.

notes: To enrol officially you also need UNEDasiss accreditation of your IB Diploma, Spain's legal access step, even though IE admits you itself.
A No Admission decision is final for the whole cycle: you cannot reapply in a later round for 2027.
The application fee is a non-refundable €150, and the whole admissions process runs in English.
